claims.text: Every call through an enforced executor is decided by the gate before the executor runs; a BLOCK verdict in enforce mode prevents the call.
After BLOCK the agent is held in Safe State and every later action of that agent is blocked until it is reset.
New installs run in shadow mode: verdicts are recorded and never enforced.
If an axiom or the gate itself raises, the action is blocked in enforce mode and allowed but logged in shadow mode.
The kill-switch blocks every action of every agent, in shadow and enforce mode.
`aeon audit verify` detects a changed, removed, reordered or corrupted record and reports the first broken link.
Removing records from the end of the log is detected only when the expected head hash is supplied (`--expect-head`).
Audit writing happens on a background thread; a storage outage does not change decisions and is itself recorded once storage recovers.
Gate decision latency p99 is under 100 µs with 10 axioms (reference machine, audit off).
